notes: npm start now boots sidecar, waits for health, then opens Isaac Sim with robot controller startup flow.
hideUi startup flag keeps app-launched Isaac Sim in viewport-only mode.
Window width and height flags keep app-launched Isaac Sim in a small window.
Best app-facing address is the sidecar baseUrl, not a direct Omniverse project path.
isaacEntryPath can later point at your Isaac-side Python hook or extension script.
Stage path should match whichever Isaac scene you want robot controller to drive.
